description.zh:
过滤器名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：

- SupplierUid：服务商UID。

- RegistrationId：审核ID。

- Status：审核状态。

- SupplierName：服务商名称。
description.en:
The name of the filter. You can query by one or more filter names. Valid values:

- SupplierUid: The UID of the service provider.

- RegistrationId: The review ID.

- Status: The review status.

- SupplierName: The name of the service provider.
The value of the filter condition.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的行数。每页最大100行，默认为20行。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-supplier-registrations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAYChudnQUoBH+mGWFpb6oP0= --filter '[{"Value":["sr-xxx"],"Name":"SupplierUid"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
